description: Phase 6 Wave 2 — Plan 02: Value Designer route handler. No web search, no deep research. Base branch: ralph/phase-6-merged.

userStories.title: Implement Value Designer route handler at /api/chat/value-designer/[projectId]
userStories.description: As a student, I need to send messages in the Value Designer tab and receive streamed responses from the VD agent using its full facilitation workflow system prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Route has `export const runtime = 'nodejs'` at top
Route reads `currentSession` from POST body with default 1
Route injects session: `const systemWithSession = \`${vdContext}\n\n[Current FUND II Session: ${currentSession} of 10]\``
Route uses `const AGENT_TYPE = 'value-designer'` as a constant (not read from request body)
Route filters message history: `prisma.message.findMany({ where: { projectId, agentType: AGENT_TYPE }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } })`
Route uses `streamText` with `model: vertex('gemini-2.5-flash')` — NO `tools` key at all
Route persists user message with `agentType: AGENT_TYPE`
Route persists assistant message with `agentType: AGENT_TYPE` in onFinish
Route uses the same rolling window logic as the Trend Mapper route (first 4 + last 40 messages)
Route uses the same streaming response headers as Trend Mapper (X-Accel-Buffering, Cache-Control)
File does NOT contain the string `tools:` (confirms no web search)
userStories.notes: Read src/app/api/chat/[projectId]/route.ts fully first — copy its structure exactly but: (1) use getValueDesignerContext() instead of getSystemContext(), (2) hardcode AGENT_TYPE = 'value-designer', (3) remove ALL tools. The rolling window, streaming headers, error handling, and onFinish pattern must be identical to Trend Mapper.
